name: element.resolve
title: Resolve reference
summary: Resolve a reference from another tool (UUID, short ID or identifier, optional version, or a test name's reference to an acceptance criterion) and tell whether the version is current.

ref.description: UUID, short ID or identifier of the element, any case; or the reference to one of its acceptance criteria as a test name writes it (SR-205 AK5): `[SR-036/AK-k7f3]`, or `SR-036/AK-k7f3` without brackets, split at the first `/` as enrich-junit reads it. A bracket token without such a suffix or with another one (`[SR-036]`, `[SR-036/slow]`) names the element. A suffix that names a criterion by its number (`AK` and a number) is refused with input.invalid and `details.reason` `criterion-by-number`, as test names name criteria by key (SR-029 AK13); one that tries to name a criterion in another form (`AK-x`, or the number 0) with `details.reason` `criterion-malformed`.

version.description: The version the reference stores (D-013); optional. A version of normal form n1 or n2 is compared with the current version in its own form; a version of another normal form is refused with input.invalid (ADR-0005).

versionDate.description: Also give the date of the current version (`versionDate`, D-013, ADR-0005), read from the Git history, as element.get does with the same input. Without it no git runs and `versionDate` is left out.

repository.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: the workspace name of its repository, as details.candidates of ref.ambiguous give it (for example one copy of a file whose UUID another file shares, SR-088; ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#255). Only the elements ref names count; when none of them lies there, the error is ref.unknown with them as details.candidates.

file.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: its file, relative to its repository, as details.candidates of ref.ambiguous give it (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#255). Give repository too when the same path is in several repositories; when several elements are still left, the error is ref.ambiguous with them.

element.description: The element as element.get shows it, with title, text, status, current version in normal form n2 (SR-060 AK1, ADR-0005), verification status per view it is in (SR-031, SR-034, SR-047 AK3) and validation status (SR-038) and, with the input `versionDate`, the date of that version (as element.get gives it; left out without the input). Without a version (a value that counts has no normal form) `version` and `versionDate` are left out and the hints end with a `file.faulty` warning, as in element.get (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#276). An unknown reference is the error ref.unknown, one that fits several elements ref.ambiguous with details.candidates (AK3). A short ID whose prefix fits no element stays ref.unknown, never another element; when its tail fits exactly one element of another type, details.candidates names that element and the message asks whether its short ID was meant (prefix may be outdated, ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#275).

criterion.description: With a reference to an acceptance criterion: that criterion of the current version, with its number, key, text and reference (SR-205 AK5). A key no criterion of the current version carries is ref.unknown with `details.criterion`; a key two criteria carry (SR-204 AK10) is ref.ambiguous with the element as the one candidate and their numbers in `details.criteria`. Left out without such a reference.

current.description: Whether the given version is the element's current version, computed from its file as it is now (SR-060 AK2): "current" or "outdated"; "unknown" when the element has no version to compare with (a value that counts has no normal form, `.inf` or `.nan`, ADR-0005: `element` comes without `version` and with a `file.faulty` warning that says why, ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#276); null when no version was given. Strings, not booleans, so a caller that tests the field for truth never takes "unknown" for current.

names.description: The elements the element names by UUID only, as element.get gives them: the variants of `validity`, `replacedBy` and `excludedBy`, the replacements and the views of `verification` (SR-046 AK1/AK2, SR-047 AK3, ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#588, #456). Left out when it names none.

incomplete.description: A repository of the workspace is not here (SR-006 AK2): replacements, exclusions and records stored there are missing (#456).
